requirements.Title: AI Productivity and Manageability Solutions
requirements.Description: Integrate advanced AI-driven productivity features and scan workflow solutions that enhance print, scan, and device management for SMB customers. Includes AI-powered print and scan optimization, and proactive support features.
requirements.Rationale: SMBs require easy-to-use, efficient solutions that reduce manual intervention and streamline workflows, especially with limited IT resources.
requirements.Stakeholders: Marketing, GXD, R&D Telemetry, Quality, BA
requirements.Dependencies: Requires SMB portal, device telemetry, and AI software integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: AI features demonstrably reduce manual steps in common workflows by at least 30% in user testing; AI-driven recommendations and error handling available in product UI.

requirements.Title: Lowest Business TCO (Total Cost of Ownership)
requirements.Description: Design the printer to deliver the lowest total cost of ownership for SMBs, including high-yield ink tanks, minimal maintenance, and energy efficiency.
requirements.Rationale: Cost efficiency is a top priority for SMBs with limited budgets; a low TCO is a key differentiator in the segment.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires efficient ink tank design, maintenance-free or low-maintenance hardware, and energy-efficient components.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Third-party TCO analysis confirms at least 10% lower TCO compared to top competitors under typical SMB usage.

requirements.Title: Customer Replaceable Maintenance Box
requirements.Description: Introduce a replaceable maintenance box that can be easily swapped by the customer without service technician intervention.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces downtime and service costs for SMBs without dedicated IT support.
requirements.Stakeholders: Quality, R&D Telemetry, Tech Reg, Marketing
requirements.Dependencies: Requires new hardware design and service documentation.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: 80% of surveyed SMB users can replace the maintenance box successfully within 5 minutes using only the provided instructions.

requirements.Title: SMB Device Management Portal
requirements.Description: Develop a consolidated web-based portal for SMBs to manage their fleet of printers, monitor usage, receive alerts, and access support.
requirements.Rationale: Unmanaged and lightly managed SMBs need simple, centralized management tools to operate efficiently without dedicated IT staff.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires device telemetry integration and secure web portal development.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Portal supports registration, usage monitoring, and alerting for at least 15 devices per account; >90% of beta users report satisfaction with portal usability.

requirements.Title: High Serviceability – PHA and MINK
requirements.Description: Enable key printer components (PHA) to be customer replaceable and MINK to be service center replaceable, with a target of making MINK customer replaceable if out of warranty.
requirements.Rationale: Improves uptime and reduces operational costs for SMBs; aligns with limited IT resources in target segment.
requirements.Stakeholders: Quality, R&D Telemetry, Tech Reg, Prod Steward
requirements.Dependencies: Requires modular hardware design and clear service documentation.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Service time for PHA replacement by customer <10 minutes; MINK replacement process documented and validated for service centers.

requirements.Title: Keyed Ink Bottles
requirements.Description: Implement keyed ink bottles to prevent incorrect refilling and ensure compatibility with Magellan printers.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces errors and service calls due to incorrect ink usage; improves customer experience and device reliability.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires new bottle design and packaging changes.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: No more than 1% of support calls related to ink refilling errors in first 12 months post-launch.

requirements.Title: Support for PaaS (Printing as a Service)
requirements.Description: Ensure the printer supports integration with HP's Printing as a Service (PaaS) offerings, including remote monitoring, automated supplies replenishment, and usage analytics.
requirements.Rationale: Enables recurring revenue models and provides SMBs with predictable costs and proactive support.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires connectivity, telemetry, and integration with HP PaaS backend.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer can be onboarded to HP PaaS platform and supports automated supplies ordering and usage reporting.

requirements.Title: PDL/PS Support and Speed Improvements
requirements.Description: For PDL SKUs, support PCL/PS printing languages and achieve print speeds of 25/20 ppm (improved from current 25/19).
requirements.Rationale: Meets the needs of more demanding SMB environments and ensures compatibility with business applications.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires firmware and hardware updates for speed and language support.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PDL SKU achieves rated speeds in independent benchmark tests; PCL/PS compatibility validated with major OS and applications.

requirements.Title: Blue Angel Certification
requirements.Description: Obtain Blue Angel eco-label certification for the PDL SKU, demonstrating compliance with environmental and sustainability standards.
requirements.Rationale: Addresses growing customer and regulatory demand for sustainable products; provides a competitive differentiator.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires product design and documentation to meet Blue Angel requirements.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PDL SKU receives official Blue Angel certification prior to launch.

requirements.Title: High Recycled Content Plastic (RCP)
requirements.Description: Design the printer with at least 60% recycled content plastic, exceeding competitors like Epson (30%).
requirements.Rationale: Supports HP's sustainability goals and appeals to environmentally conscious SMB customers.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires sourcing and validation of high-RCP materials.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Bill of materials and third-party audit confirm at least 60% RCP in product housing.

requirements.Title: Mobile Printing and HP App Integration
requirements.Description: Enable seamless mobile printing and management through the HP App, supporting major mobile platforms and workflows.
requirements.Rationale: SMBs require flexible, on-the-go printing and device management, especially with hybrid work trends.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires mobile app development and printer connectivity features.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer is discoverable and usable via HP App on iOS/Android; >90% success rate in mobile print tasks during user testing.

requirements.Title: Advanced Telemetry for Device Health and Usage
requirements.Description: Incorporate advanced telemetry features to monitor device health, usage patterns, and proactively alert users/service providers of issues.
requirements.Rationale: Enables predictive maintenance, reduces downtime, and supports manageability for SMBs.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires secure data transmission and integration with management portal.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Telemetry data available to users and HP backend; >95% accuracy in predictive failure alerts in pilot deployments.
